snapshot.title: Universal first-time mechanic tutorial system
snapshot.description: When a mission type introduces a new mechanic (refining, construction, etc.), a tutorial overlay triggers exactly once on first attempt. Universal post-M4 onboarding pattern.

acceptanceCriteria.text: System detects when player accepts a mission type for the first time
Inline tutorial overlay triggered on first attempt of that mission type
Tutorial covers: what the mechanic is, how to do it, what to expect
Tutorial never shown twice for the same mechanic
Applies to: construction, refining, off-world refinery, room upgrades, and any future new mechanic

## Summary
MechanicIntroCatalog.gd: content for room_upgrades, scanner_station, construction, refining, off_world_refinery, free_operations, marketplace.
FirstTimeMechanicTracker.gd: persists to mechanic_intros_seen.json; maybe_show(key, tree) shows overlay exactly once.
MechanicIntroOverlay.gd: self-building CanvasLayer overlay with icon+title, 3 sections (what/how/expect), dismiss button.
AppControllerHelper.maybe_show_mechanic_intro(key): one-line hook for any future scene.
Wired: room_upgrades in GameNavigationMenu._do_room_upgrade(); scanner_station in SatelliteStationPanel._ready().
